full_judgment: "Burdensome Condition means subject to Clause 25(c) of this Scheme, a condition, limitation or reduction or withdrawal of an existing authorization imposed by a Government Authority that could reasonably be expected to have a material adverse impact on the Transferee Company as the surviving corporation or which the Shareholders of the parties decide as unacceptable."
